description: Read records from any IANA XML registry by id, e.g. registry "tls-parameters" with subregistry "tls-parameters-4" (TLS Cipher Suites), "protocol-numbers", "http-methods", or "cbor-tags"; an iana.org/assignments URL also works. Filter with `value` (exact match on the key column, or on the column `field` names; digits compare by number with a cell of digits ("0443" finds "443") and one 0x token with a one-token 0x cell ("0x5" finds "0x05"), each also matching its own kind of range row ("105-199", "0x11-0xff"); other 0x forms compare their digits as written, in any comma, space, or brace spelling) and `contains` (words in any field; records with a field equal to the words come first). When a registry has several sub-registries and none is given, the response lists them instead of records; a table that nests tables lists them too. Field names are the registry's XML element names (e.g. "rec" is the Recommended column). Large registries page through `cursor`. Find ids with iana_search_registries.

contains.description: Words matched as whole tokens against every field and reference id, e.g. "chacha20". Records with a field equal to the words come first.

cursor.description: next_cursor from the previous page; reuse it only with the same registry, subregistry, value, field, and contains.

field.description: Column for value to match instead of the key column, case-insensitive, one of the names in columns: e.g. "type" for a DNS RR type mnemonic, or "name" for every row of a service name. Ignored without value.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return, 1–100. Default 25.

registry.description: Registry id, e.g. "tls-parameters", or its https://www.iana.org/assignments/<id> URL (a #fragment selects the sub-registry when subregistry is unset).

subregistry.description: Sub-registry id, case-insensitive, e.g. "tls-parameters-4". Omit to read the only sub-registry, or to list them when there are several.

value.description: Exact match on the key column named by value_field (value, else number, else the first column), or on field when set; case and whitespace are ignored. A value of digits compares by number with a cell of digits, so "0443" finds "443", and also matches range rows such as "105-199"; it never matches a 0x cell. One 0x token compares by number with a one-token 0x cell, so "0x5" finds "0x05", and also matches range rows such as "0x11-0xff". Any other pair of 0x forms compares the digits as written: "0x1301", "{0x13,0x01}", and "0x13 0x01" all find "0x13,0x01", while "0x13" never finds "0x00,0x13".

name: iana_get_registry_records

columns.description: Field (XML element) names seen, first-seen order, the first 50.

description.description: Description of the table read, or of the registry when listing; a YANG module registry names its module file here. At most 2,000 characters.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `unknown_registry`: The registry XML returns 404 and no case-insensitive index match exists, or the index is unavailable. `unknown_subregistry`: The subregistry id is not in this registry. `unknown_field`: The field, given with value, is not a column of the table read. `non_xml_registry`: The registry, or the sub-registry read, holds no XML records and points at a file published separately, such as plain text or a MIB module. `invalid_cursor`: The cursor is not one this tool returned: malformed, corrupted, or carrying an offset or limit that is not a whole number of zero or more. `cursor_mismatch`: The cursor was minted for a different registry, subregistry, value, field, or contains. `upstream_unreadable`: The registry XML could not be read, was not XML, or was larger than this server accepts. `pacer_shed`: This server's own iana.org request queue is too full for the call to start in time. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

next_cursor.description: Pass as cursor, with the same filters, for the next page.

notes.description: Notes of the table read (of the registry, when listing), first page only. With registry_notes: the first 25 and 4,000 characters at most, these first.

anchor.description: Anchor that note references point at.

notes_truncated.description: True when notes or registry_notes were cut at 4,000 characters.

notice.description: Guidance on a miss, a cut list, or another condition.

offset.description: Matching records before this page, on pages after the first.

records.description: Records in registry order (with contains, records with a field equal to the words first), up to limit and a 48,000-character page budget.

cut_fields.description: Fields cut at 2,000 characters (ending in …) or past the 16-field cap, the first 32.

fields.description: Values keyed by XML element name, each capped at 2,000 characters.

references.description: References on the record, the first 25.

id.description: E.g. "RFC 9110", a draft name, a registry id, or a URL.

label.description: Label text, when it adds to id and section.

value.description: The record's value_field cell; absent when the record has none.

references.description: The documents that define the table read, the first 25.

id.description: E.g. "RFC 9110", a draft name, a registry id, or a URL.

label.description: Label text, when it adds to id and section.

registration_procedure.description: Registration rule of the table read, or of the registry when listing; at most 2,000 characters.

registration_ranges.description: Allocation ranges, when the table defines them: the first 25, each text at most 2,000 characters.

registry_notes.description: The registry root's notes and footnotes, on the first page of a sub-registry read; records cite them by anchor. Shares the notes caps, after notes.

anchor.description: Anchor that note references point at.

source.description: Provenance and freshness of the answer.

fetched_at.description: ISO 8601 time of the last successful fetch or revalidation.

registry_id.description: Id of the registry file that answered.

registry_updated.description: The registry's own last-updated date; absent for the protocol index.

stale.description: True when a refresh failed and a cached copy up to 7 days old answered.

subregistries.description: Tables to read next, the first 250: every sub-registry when one must be chosen (records is then empty), or the tables nested directly in the table read, on its first page.

subregistry_id.description: Id of the sub-registry the records come from.

totalCount.description: Matches before the limit was applied.

truncated.description: True when more matches exist than were returned.

value_field.description: The table's key column: each record's value comes from it, and the value filter matches it unless field names another.

title: Read IANA registry records
